## Security and licence milestone gate

- [ ] Threat model and trust boundaries updated.
- [ ] Manual security review completed; no approval bypasses or destructive actions introduced.
- [ ] Security tests use isolated directories and synthetic data.
- [ ] Dependencies pinned and scanned; CVEs triaged without assuming clean means secure.
- [ ] Third-party licences, assets and SBOM impact reviewed.
- [ ] Findings and exceptions recorded in the remediation tracker.
- [ ] No unresolved Critical or exploitable High finding.
- [ ] No unresolved licence incompatibility.
